title: Logging
summary: Server activity logging — pick a channel per log type (or per whole category), self-posted or via webhook, with ignore lists for noisy channels/roles/users.

sections.heading: Log types
sections.body: Grouped into categories (Bot, Custom Commands, Applications, Channels, Roles, Members, Messages, Voice, and more) — expand a category to set a channel for each type inside it individually, or set the whole category at once. Custom Command Used records custom command execution with the user, channel, and command name.

sections.heading: Self-post vs. webhook
sections.body: By default NEXORIA posts log messages itself. A channel can instead be set to use a webhook — useful for custom branding in that channel — but since anyone who obtains the webhook URL can post to it, this is opt-in per channel with a warning before you turn it on.

sections.heading: Ignore lists
sections.body: Channels, roles, and users can be excluded from logging entirely, so noisy bots or a specific channel don't flood your log channels.
